author: Home RenoVision DIY
description:
You don’t need a contractor to fix small drywall holes. In this short, I show homeowners how to repair drywall using a California patch. Its the easiest and most foolproof drywall repair method out there. This DIY drywall patch works for holes in walls and ceilings and requires minimal tools. If you want to learn how to fix drywall fast, save money, and get professional-looking results, this method is for you. If you found this video helpful, please subscribe. Hope you enjoy. Cheers!
